text: Julia: quick design check — I'm proposing a tiny change to the Alert preview panel: move the telemetry CTA from the bottom-right to inline under channel badges so it's more visible when suppression is toggled. thoughts? :thinking_face: Rashmi: sounds reasonable. main concern is visual noise in compact views. do we have space for an inline CTA without breaking density? Evan: agree with Rashmi. maybe show a subtle link (text button) instead of a full CTA in compact mode. expand to full button in expanded preview. Connor: Fwiw we need to ensure keyboard order doesn't change — focus should go channel badges -> preview toggle -> CTA. currently CTA is after the suppression switch which forces extra tabbing. Julia: good call. So: compact = text link, expanded = primary button. maintain focus order as Connor suggested. also want to add an a11y label so screen readers announce what the CTA shows (telemetry peek). Accessibility Bot: aria suggestion: add aria-label="Open telemetry preview for selected channels" to the CTA and ensure role="button" and tabindex="0" for link variant. Rashmi: copy tweak idea: instead of "View telemetry" maybe "Preview recent alerts" — clearer for users who don't know what telemetry means. shorter too. Evan: +1 for "Preview recent alerts". Also we should surface which channel the preview will use in the CTA tooltip (eg "Preview recent alerts via PagerDuty"). Connor: UX edge: when suppression is enabled for a channel the CTA should visually indicate it's using suppressed channels (e.g., muted icon) and tooltip should say "Includes suppressed channels". otherwise folks get confused why they see no notifications. Julia: good. For analytics, we want a telemetry event when CTA is clicked: {"action":"preview_open","channel_ids":[...],"suppression_on":true/false}. that'll help us understand usage. Evan can you add that to the telemetry spec? Evan: yep will add. quick question about hotkeys — should the CTA be reachable via a single key (P)? might conflict but could be a power-user option. Rashmi: I'm worried about discoverability. maybe add a small hint in the hover card: "Press P to open preview" only after user has opened it once. non-intrusive. Julia: love that. final nit: color contrast for the inline link — ensure AA contrast against both light and dark themes. Connor can you run a quick check? Connor: will do. current link color fails AA at 12px. bumping to 16px or using the elevated link token fixes it. Accessibility Bot: reminder: ensure focus ring meets 3:1 contrast with surrounding UI per keyboard-only guidance. Evan: I'll update the component: compact variant = Preview recent alerts and fire telemetry on click. Julia: thanks all. I'll push the updated mock into Figma (link) and add a short note in the PR template to run keyboard-only QA and color contrast checks. :white_check_mark:
